protocol.training:
# Paper task training recipe (Section IV-B). Copy per task, seed, and budget, changing the
# dataset path and output_dir. See docs/paper-tasks.md.
# The paper's victim and students are Qwen2.5 instruct models; this still uses the repository's
# Qwen3.5 pairing until that switch is made.
base_model = "Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B-Base"
base_revision = "b1485b2fa6dfa1287294f269f5fb618e03d52d7c"
# Victim responses for one budget, prepared from TASK_DIR/runs/sSEED-bBUDGET/ledger.jsonl.
# Use gold-train.jsonl in the same directory for the gold-label reference student.
dataset_path = "data/tasks/ag_news/runs/s42-b2000/train.jsonl"
# No validation set: victim responses for it would spend attacker budget. The epoch count is
# chosen on the gold-scored development suite instead.
output_dir = "artifacts/tasks/ag_news/s42-b2000/attacker"
eos_token = "<|im_end|>"
chat_template_kwargs = { enable_thinking = false }
max_length = 2048
# Selected per task and student size from {1e-4, 2e-4} and {1, 2, 3} on the development suite,
# then frozen across defense conditions.
learning_rate = 2e-4
epochs = 3.0
# Effective batch size 16.
per_device_batch_size = 4
gradient_accumulation_steps = 4
warmup_ratio = 0.03
logging_steps = 10
save_steps = 100
eval_strategy = "epoch"
select_best_checkpoint = false
save_total_limit = 2
seed = 42
precision = "bf16"
qlora = false
loss_type = "nll"
attn_implementation = "sdpa"
optimizer = "auto"
activation_offloading = "auto"
gradient_checkpointing = true
selective_gradient_checkpointing = false
lora_rank = 16
lora_alpha = 32
lora_dropout = 0.05
# The paper adapts attention projections. Qwen3.5's linear-attention layers name theirs
# differently, so set the explicit module list after the switch to Qwen2.5.
target_modules = "all-linear"
